name: Construire l'APK de debug

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'mobile/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-apk-debug.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Récupérer le code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Installer Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Installer Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - name: Installer les dépendances
        working-directory: mobile
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Compléter les fichiers du projet Flutter (dossiers manquants)
        working-directory: mobile
        run: flutter create . --platforms android,web --project-name app_bd_ia

      - name: Générer l'icône de l'app
        working-directory: mobile
        run: dart run flutter_launcher_icons

      - name: Construire l'APK de debug
        working-directory: mobile
        run: flutter build apk --debug

      - name: Publier l'APK en release téléchargeable
        uses: ncipollo/release-action@v1
        with:
          tag: apk-debug-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: APK de debug #${{ github.run_number }}
          artifacts: mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          allowUpdates: true
